item.title: 🔵 Announcing Claude Compliance API support with Cloudflare CASB
item.description:
Why this matters: Regulatory/compliance signal — assess applicability and remediation timeline.
Cloudflare now integrates with the Claude Compliance API, so that security teams can monitor Claude Enterprise activity directly in the Cloudflare Dashboard.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago
